g.text: . If a file won't run, fix it: chmod +x filename
cat item Read the script before running it
file item Check what type of file it is
NEVER run a script you haven't read first!
In the real world, unknown scripts can be dangerous.
🗡️ treasure* — Collect a weapon for your inventory
🧪 potion* — Gain health points for combat
cd chamber Advance to the inner chamber
